story: In one minute a visitor understands that I am an AI engineer, sees a real run, and can reach the architecture of a project.

scenes.proof: Name, role, three evidence-backed results, a demo button and a WhatsApp button, all as HTML text
scenes.reducedMotion: Same hero. The background is a single rendered frame, or the level 1 layers
scenes.mobile: Same HTML. Portrait screens keep the level 1 background
scenes.focus: Skip link first, then the header, then the first call to action

scenes.proof: One card per stop, hung on a billboard in its part of the city; the camera parks on it and the next billboard shows ahead
scenes.reducedMotion: A static frame per stop: the card sits on its billboard, no swing, no events
scenes.mobile: Cards in page order, no canvas on portrait screens, the menu is a bar with previous and next
scenes.focus: The menu, then the card of the current stop; the other cards are inert previews

scenes.proof: Choosing a project plays four stripes over the page change and opens that project's case; the scene holds at its object
scenes.focus: The page starts at the top, on the case heading, after navigation

scenes.proof: Three chapters with a banner, a body and one action each: run it, the flow with its diagram and its scenarios, the README with its decisions, failures and numbers; the summary and the honesty links stay above them
scenes.reducedMotion: The diagram walkthrough changes scenes with no travelling token
scenes.mobile: The tab bar scrolls sideways; sections are stacked inside a tab
scenes.focus: Tabs by arrow keys, Home and End; Tab moves into the open panel

scenes.proof: The game menu lists the six districts, marks the active one and lists its projects under it; j and k step one stop and the number keys jump to a district
scenes.mobile: A bar at the bottom with Previous, the current station name and Next
scenes.focus: Station links in order, the current one marked with aria-current; the bar buttons are real buttons

scenes.proof: About, then the WhatsApp button, phone, e-mail, LinkedIn and GitHub on the last card, at the harbour
Stack status, budget left, and the model, tokens, latency and cost of each step of a real run
scenes.reducedMotion: The scene events are not sent; the run log shows the same numbers
scenes.mobile: Status, budget and log stacked; start button above the accounts
scenes.focus: Start button, then the account list, then the log
